messages:
cheng: Heads-up — noticed reserved GPU pool utilization mismatch in us-west-2. reservation 'res-2' shows 82% attached but billing shows 95% charged to untagged resources. Anyone looking at reservation coverage?

alex: I saw a similar pattern in eu-west earlier. Might be nodepool label drift after autoscaler replaced nodes. :eyes:

marie: Quick dump from the tag audit: 
```
$ gcloud compute reservations list --filter="labels.cost-center:*" --format=json
[{"name":"res-1","labels":{"cost-center":"infra"}},{"name":"res-2","labels":{}}]
```
res-2 has empty labels.

sam: finance-bot already flagged an invoice anomaly — ~18% overcommit vs reserved. I forwarded the alert to billing@.

finance-bot: Alert (FINANCE): Reservation coverage delta for us-west-2 = +13% (billed > committed). Suggested actions: reconcile labels, reassign reservations, or submit reservation change request. Ticket FIN-2321 created.

ops-bot: Suggestion: run backfill script: `scripts/tagbackfill.sh res-2 team=platform owner=platform-ops` — but confirm owners first.

alex: Careful — res-2 is attached to an old nodepool `n1-gpu-legacy-pool`. Re-labeling cloud reservations is safe, but changing nodepool labels might break chargeback mapping if we do it at k8s level. We should only update cloud billing labels for now.

cheng: Proposed plan:
1) Identify instances consuming reserved capacity without billing tags:
   - `aws ec2 describe-instances --filters Name=tag:cost-center,Values=none --query 'Reservations[].Instances[].InstanceId'`
2) Backfill cloud labels for matching reservations (audit-friendly tag updates)
3) Run chargeback allocator to produce CSV for finance (reservation_id, instance_id, allocated_team, window)
4) If no owner found, temporarily assign to `platform-global` with label `team=pending-owner` and track in ticket.

marie: I'll run steps 1+2 now and post outputs. Won't touch k8s labels. :thumbsup:

sam: Finance requests retrospective allocation for the previous billing cycle. We need a CSV mapping usage -> team for the last 30 days. Can we produce that by EOD?

ira: Quick question — will backfilling cloud labels before the reconciliation risk reattributing live costs in the current cycle? We don't want a sudden charge jump for product teams.

cheng: We will only annotate billing metadata with an `audit:reconciled=YYYY-MM-DD` tag so that chargeback scripts can choose whether to include those backfilled events retroactively. No live reattach operations.

alex: If backfill doesn't reconcile coverage, consider changing reservation granularity next month (regional vs zonal) or resizing commitments. Fragmentation is causing a lot of wasted coverage.

sam: Agreed. Marie, include a column `suggested_next_action` in the CSV (backfill/assign/resize) so finance can decide chargeback vs absorb.

marie: Uploaded preliminary CSV to /shared/infra/recon-1951234567.csv. Sample rows:
instance_id,reservation_id,consuming_team,suggested_next_action
i-0abcd,res-2,unattributed,backfill
i-0efgh,res-2,platform,assign
...

finance-bot: FIN-2321 updated: retrospective chargeback requested. Please add the CSV and a short justification note.

cheng: Thanks everyone. Let's sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to finalize allocation and any reservation changes. I'll send calendar invite.

marie: Added meeting invite and included the CSV link.

alex: One more note — put a guard in the tagbackfill script to skip instances with label `billing:do-not-touch=true`. We have a few experimental clusters.

cheng: Good call. Ops-bot — can you add that check?

ops-bot: Done. Updated script `tagbackfill.sh` to skip `billing:do-not-touch=true` and log skipped instances to /logs/tagbackfill/1951234567.log.

sam: Finance: will follow up on FIN-2321 after the meeting.

cheng: End of thread.
